'''2007 Worlds Team Jonny Chu LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

TEAM LIGHT. Fax OCR poor; Master Luke×8, Panaka×7, Corellian Corvette×11 best-effort from OCR.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jonny Chu]]

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
